name: Flash FM
summary: Iconic returning pop and dance station delivering chart-topping commercial hits, summer anthems, and humorous celebrity parody commentary.
description: Originating in 1986's Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, Flash FM returns in GTA VI fully modernized for the 2020s. Balancing nostalgia with current pop titans, Flash FM provides an energetic backdrop to high-speed police chases and casual beach drives. Commercial breaks satirize modern influencer culture and fast-fashion consumerism.

seo.title: Flash FM: GTA VI Pop Radio Guide
seo.description: Flash FM returns in GTA VI. Complete station history, confirmed pop playlist, radio host commentary, and satirical commercial spots.
